title: Messy, NOT Biodegradable
text: Messy, NOT Biodegradable. I had a pack of poppers a while back. They were biodegradable rice paper. Shot them into the yard, it rained, the mess dissolved. Poof, gone. I didn't pay attention and we took these out into the yard, they were VERY hard to activate which being disabled I found to be a rather annoying but at least it keeps kids from setting them off. My issue is they're full of shards of what appears to be Mylar wrapping paper and it's EVERYWHERE. And being disabled I'm stuck with it. Maybe I can convince my lawn guy to clean it up. These things should always have biodegradable contents. BTW, use caution setting these off indoors. They're nearly as loud as my 9mm. We set one off under the edge of my porch roof and the report was enough to make my ears ring for several hours. These are not toys.
